entries.message: Its parts (first name, city and so on) are QAF's own name parts.
A number with a calculation is a calculation field.
Its default "{embed_url}" is a Gravity Forms merge tag QAF does not have.
QAF has no field like Gravity Forms' "coupon".
A condition on field 99 with "is" could not be read.
Its routing rules (send to different people by answer) have no place in the model.
